```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pyscf import gto, dft
import numpy as np
sm='CC1C2OC(=N)C12C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(sm))
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=17)
print('RDKit conformer status:',status)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
print('MMFF optimization status:',AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=500))
conf=m.GetConformer()
coords=conf.GetPositions()
atoms=[]
for atom,xyz in zip(m.GetAtoms(),coords): atoms.append((atom.GetSymbol(),tuple(float(x) for x in xyz)))
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='6-31g*',unit='Angstrom',charge=0,spin=0,verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='b3lyp'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9
energy=calc.kernel()
moe=calc.mo_energy
occ=calc.mo_occ
homo_idx=np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]
print('SCF converged:',calc.converged)
print('Method: B3LYP/6-31G*, gas-phase RKS single point on RDKit-MMFF geometry')
print('Total energy (Ha):',float(energy))
print('HOMO index (0-based):',int(homo_idx))
print('HOMO energy (Ha):',float(moe[homo_idx]))
print('LUMO energy (Ha):',float(moe[homo_idx+1]))
```
